top_violation_types.title: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation-May not delegate responsibility to report (26 TAC §746.201(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During a DFPS investigation, it was found that the operation staff was notified of possible abuse against a child in care and the operation did not report to licensing.

top_violation_types.title: Plan to Handle Transportation Emergencies (26 TAC §746.5619)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no plan to handle transportation emergencies.

top_violation_types.title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A table manufactured for use with safety straps does not have safety straps on it. Children were observed at the table without being strapped in.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver was observed in direct care of 11 children with three of those children being ages 0-17 months of age; the maximum number of children to be   supervised by one caregiver was 7, therefore the caregiver was over by 4 children.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: CPSC form was not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Director was lacking current transportation training. The operation provides transportation.
